# MCP schema fixtures

These files are unmodified copies from the official Model Context Protocol
specification repository at the release tags:

- [2025-11-25](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/2025-11-25/schema/2025-11-25/schema.json), tag `2025-11-25`.
- [2026-07-28](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/2026-07-28/schema/2026-07-28/schema.json), tag `2026-07-28`.

The test helper selects a definition with a root reference, retaining the
fixture's definitions. The validator is a development dependency only.
